title: DAPA-HF: Study to Evaluate the Effect of Dapagliflozin on the Incidence of Worsening Heart Failure or Cardiovascular Death in Patients With Chronic Heart Failure
condition: heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, with or without type 2 diabetes

criteria.sentence: Provision of signed informed consent prior to any study specific procedures

rule.unevaluable_reason: Informed consent is not in the synthetic records
rule.label: Signed informed consent

criteria.sentence: Established documented diagnosis of symptomatic HFrEF (NYHA functional class II-IV), which has been present for at least 2 months

rule.unevaluable_reason: NYHA class, ejection fraction and diagnosis dates are not in the synthetic data
rule.label: Symptomatic HFrEF (NYHA II-IV) for 2+ months

rule.unevaluable_reason: LVEF is not in the synthetic data
rule.label: LVEF <= 40%

rule.unevaluable_reason: NT-proBNP is not in the synthetic data
rule.label: Elevated NT-proBNP

criteria.sentence: Patients should receive background standard of care for HFrEF and be treated according to locally recognized guidelines

rule.unevaluable_reason: Guideline heart failure therapy is not in the synthetic records
rule.label: On standard HFrEF care

criteria.sentence: eGFR ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m^2 (CKD-EPI formula) at enrolment (visit 1)
Receiving therapy with an SGLT2 inhibitor within 8 weeks prior to enrolment or previous intolerance of an SGLT2 inhibitor

rule.unevaluable_reason: SGLT2 inhibitors are not in the synthetic medication list, and the 8-week window needs dates
rule.label: Exclude recent SGLT2 inhibitor use or intolerance

criteria.sentence: Symptomatic hypotension or systolic BP <95 mmHg at 2 out of 3 measurements either at visit 1 or visit 2

rule.unevaluable_reason: Symptoms and repeated visit BP readings are not in the synthetic data; it has one BP value
rule.label: Exclude symptomatic hypotension or SBP < 95

criteria.sentence: Current acute decompensated HF or hospitalization due to decompensated HF <4 weeks prior to enrolment

rule.unevaluable_reason: Acute decompensation and hospitalization dates are not in the synthetic data
rule.label: Exclude acute decompensated HF (4-week window)

criteria.sentence: MI, unstable angina, stroke or transient ischemic attack within 12 weeks prior to enrolment

rule.unevaluable_reason: 12-week event window needs dates; the synthetic data has no dates
rule.label: Exclude recent MI/stroke/unstable angina/TIA (12-week window)

criteria.sentence: Coronary revascularization (percutaneous coronary intervention or coronary artery bypass grafting) or valvular repair/replacement within 12 weeks prior to enrolment or planned to undergo any of these operations after randomization

rule.unevaluable_reason: Procedures and their dates are not in the synthetic data
rule.label: Exclude recent or planned revascularization or valve surgery

criteria.sentence: Implantation of a CRT within 12 weeks prior to enrolment or intent to implant a CRT device

rule.unevaluable_reason: Device implants and their dates are not in the synthetic data
rule.label: Exclude recent or planned CRT implant

criteria.sentence: Previous cardiac transplantation or implantation of a ventricular assistance device or similar device, or implantation expected after randomization

rule.unevaluable_reason: Transplants and device implants are not in the synthetic data
rule.label: Exclude heart transplant or ventricular assist device

criteria.sentence: HF due to restrictive cardiomyopathy, active myocarditis, constrictive pericarditis, hypertrophic (obstructive) cardiomyopathy or uncorrected primary valvular disease

rule.unevaluable_reason: The cause of heart failure is not in the synthetic data
rule.label: Exclude HF from restrictive/hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, myocarditis, pericarditis or valve disease

criteria.sentence: Symptomatic bradycardia or second or third degree heart block without a pacemaker

rule.unevaluable_reason: Heart rhythm and pacemaker status are not in the synthetic data
rule.label: Exclude symptomatic bradycardia or 2nd/3rd-degree heart block without pacemaker

criteria.sentence: Severe (eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m^2 by CKD-EPI), unstable or rapidly progressing renal disease at the time of randomization

rule.unevaluable_reason: Renal trends over time are not in the synthetic data; eGFR < 30 is counted by the eGFR >= 30 inclusion
rule.label: Exclude severe, unstable or rapidly progressing renal disease
